$comment: Sample args for the lens-review workflow, with invented values. A root review omits since, runId and rootRunId (the run id is derived as rv-<UTC stamp>-<6 hex>); a delta review gives since (the reviewed tree of the previous review) on every diff plus rootRunId, and priorFindings after a NEEDS_FIXES. Omit lenses to use workflows/review-lenses.json.
